Bash(python3 - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv\("results/fold_5/oos_returns.csv", parse_dates=["date"]\)
port = df["portfolio_return"].values.astype\(float\)
qqq  = df["qqq_return"].values.astype\(float\)

print\("=== Fold 5 OOS return stats \(2018-2019\) ==="\)
print\(f"  n weeks       : {len\(port\)}"\)
print\(f"  Port mean     : {port.mean\(\):.6f}  \({port.mean\(\)*52*100:.2f}% ann\)"\)
print\(f"  Port std      : {port.std\(\):.6f}"\)
print\(f"  Port min/max  : {port.min\(\):.6f} / {port.max\(\):.6f}"\)
print\(f"  QQQ  mean     : {qqq.mean\(\):.6f}  \({qqq.mean\(\)*52*100:.2f}% ann\)"\)
print\(f"  QQQ  std      : {qqq.std\(\):.6f}"\)
print\(f"  QQQ  min/max  : {qqq.min\(\):.6f} / {qqq.max\(\):.6f}"\)

print\("\\n=== Beta calculation breakdown ==="\)
cov_pq   = np.cov\(port, qqq\)[0,1]
var_q    = np.var\(qqq, ddof=1\)
raw_beta = cov_pq / var_q
print\(f"  Cov\(port, QQQ\) : {cov_pq:.8f}"\)
print\(f"  Var\(QQQ\)       : {var_q:.8f}"\)
print\(f"  Raw beta       : {raw_beta:.4f}"\)

# With winsorisation \(as in compute_beta_to_qqq\)
winsor = 0.02
lo_p, hi_p = np.percentile\(port, [winsor*100, \(1-winsor\)*100]\)
lo_q, hi_q = np.percentile\(qqq,  [winsor*100, \(1-winsor\)*100]\)
p_w = np.clip\(port, lo_p, hi_p\)
q_w = np.clip\(qqq,  lo_q, hi_q\)
slope, _, _, _, _ = stats.linregress\(q_w, p_w\)
print\(f"  Winsorised beta: {slope:.4f}"\)

print\("\\n=== Outlier check: weeks where |port| > 3× std ==="\)
thresh = port.std\(\) * 3
outliers = df[np.abs\(port\) > thresh][["date","portfolio_return","qqq_return"]]
print\(outliers.to_string\(index=False\) if len\(outliers\) else "  None"\)

print\("\\n=== Correlation ==="\)
print\(f"  Pearson r: {np.corrcoef\(port, qqq\)[0,1]:.4f}"\)
print\(f"  Pearson r \(winsorised\): {np.corrcoef\(p_w, q_w\)[0,1]:.4f}"\)
EOF)
